notes.title: Pie update. 0.3.14
notes.content:
Patch 0.3.14, the Pie update. The games price has been reduced for the final time before the games full release, this will be the cheapest the game will sell for. 

After the rooms and planets are complete, and some other gameplay elements the game will double in price. As the game is nearing completion, there is not that much left to do.
